notes.title: Gecko Gods - Demo Patch
notes.content: [h2]Hey Geckos! 🦎[/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve been absolutely blown away by the love and support you’ve shown during Steam’s June Next Fest. It’s been an incredible experience seeing so many of you explore our world for the very first time - thank you![/p][p]We’ve been carefully listening to your feedback, and we’ve just pushed a [b]hotfix patch[/b] to smooth out some rough edges and improve your experience. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]toggle sprint[/b] option in the Accessibility settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]unlock mouse cursor[/b] option in Accessibility (MHOOK compatibility)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]gap in water[/b] in the platforming section[/p][/*][*][p][b]Objectives now clear[/b] correctly when starting a new game[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed [b]audio stuttering[/b] issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]audio volume bugs[/b] when pausing/unpausing[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected [b]typos[/b] in the settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Patched several [b]out-of-bounds exploits[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with [b]camera zooming in too much[/b] in the Cathedral[/p][/*][*][p]Increased [b]auto-pickup range[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’re continuing to watch for, and action, your feedback and really appreciate everyone who’s taken the time to report bugs, suggest features, or just say kind things. It means the world to us![/p][p][/p][p]- Gecko Gods Team 💚[/p][p][/p][p]Please join our discord using the link below, where you can share any feedback, report bugs, or interact with our awesome community![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/gJ5DMjzeHJ"]Gecko Gods Discord[/url][/p]

tags.feature: Added toggle sprint option in the Accessibility settings
Added unlock mouse cursor option in Accessibility (MHOOK compatibility)

tags.bug: Fixed gap in water in the platforming section
Objectives now clear correctly when starting a new game
Fixed audio volume bugs when pausing/unpausing
Corrected typos in the settings menu
Fixed issue with camera zooming in too much in the Cathedral
